newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Andes unaware of why shrs rose.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes unaware of why shrs rose.

text.p: Pacific Andes International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was not aware of any reason behind the recent rise in its share price and trading volume.

The company was still in talks for the possible acquisition of a processing plant in China as stated in its latest annual report and there were no other negotiations or agreements discloseable under the listing rules, it said in a statement.
"The directors wish to emphasise that such negotiations have not yet been completed and no binding terms have been agreed by the relevant parties," Pacific Andes said.
Pacific Andes also said it was not possible to give any firm indication as to the timing of such acquitions or whether it would be proceeded with.
The company's shares eased HK$0.05 to HK$1.38 in Friday morning, after rising more than 12 percent to close at HK$1.43 on Tuesday.
